panel.dndExplain: Do Not Disturb silences desktop notifications and pet reactions while it is on.
panel.noSessionsHint: Start an agent session in your terminal or desktop app and it will show up here.
panel.projectPetsEmptyHint: Use "Add project" to pick a project folder and give it its own pet.
panel.renameDuplicate: Another pet already uses this name.
panel.sizeHelp: Current size: {percent}% of the original sprite.
panel.setupWizardHelp: Re-run hook installation and integration checks.
panel.sizeResetHelp: Drag the panel edges to resize it; every view shares the same size. Reset returns to the default size.
panel.jumpUnavailable: No project folder is available for this session.
panel.jumpFailed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
panel.jumpRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment.
panel.jumpSettingHelp: Adds Show project folder (selects it in Finder or File Explorer, never opens it) and Copy project path to session rows. The full path stays in the app's main process.
panel.jumpSwitchSettingHelp: macOS: brings the session's terminal or IDE to the front (not a specific window or tab); clicking a waiting-permission or waiting-input notification about one session does the same. Only apps on a known list can be activated; needs no system permission.
